 How to Watch Seton Hall vs Alabama
 When: Friday, November 13, 2026
 Time: 9:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: SEC Network
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Seton Hall has won its first three games after beating Charlotte 68-62 on Monday at the Palestra in Philadelphia. Roddie Anderson III led the Pirates with 17 points, including three three-pointers, while Devin Williams scored 16 points and Mihailo Petrovic added 12 points, six assists and three steals. Seton Hall led 36-34 at halftime and used a strong start to the second half to build an 11-point lead. Charlotte cut the lead to three points late, but the Pirates made eight of their final 10 free throws to hold on.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Alabama improved to 3-0 with a 109-68 win over Oakland on Monday. London Jemison scored 20 points, making all seven of his shots, including six three-pointers. Amari Allen added 14 points and six assists, while Aden Holloway scored 12 points. The Crimson Tide made 24 three-pointers and finished with 30 assists, tying a school record. Alabama led 56-29 at halftime and had 46 points from its bench. The Alabama offense is humming, as they have scored at least 96 points in each of the first three games.
